title: Mayonaka no Occult Koumuin: Fukurokouji to Anoko to Ore to
justification: The OAD (2019-11-22), bundled with the twelfth manga volume, is TVDB season 0 episode 1 "The Dead End, The Girl and Me" (2019-11-22, 25 minutes, the bundled episode by its overview) and TMDB 85935 season 0 episode 3 "The Blind Alley, the Boy, and I" (2019-11-22). Offset 1 sent it to TVDB episode 2 "Lonely Vampire", AniDB 14172's special, and TMDB episode 2. TVDB also lists an undated placeholder "The Blind Alley, the Boy, and I" at episode 4. The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
